title: 7 AI agents vs 1 loop: score tripled, then it wiped an address
description:
I ran Anthropic's own fold-your-subagents kit on a free 3B model: 8/38 tasks before, 26/38 after. Then the single loop overwrote a customer's address when asked to read it.

Run by me on a CPU (Llama 3.2 3B via Ollama), the kit's own 19 tasks, 2 runs each. Not Claude, not a benchmark; Anthropic's claims stay Anthropic's.
